observations: Photo 0: front of a small black tower desktop UPS with a blue front strip, one power button and three indicator lights; the lights are off.
Photo 0: 'BLUE GATE' is moulded on the front panel above the strip.
Photo 1: the same unit from above at an angle; a mains cable with a three pin plug lies on top; the case is dusty but not cracked or dented.
Photo 1: the case is small, the size of a home or office computer UPS, room for one or two small sealed batteries.
Neither photo shows the rating plate, the model or capacity, the rear sockets, or the unit switched on.
No photo shows the battery or its date label.

identity.kind: small desktop UPS for a computer

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show a Blue Gate desktop UPS.
No photo of the battery, its label or purchase date; the unit is never shown powered.
No clip of it running on battery; a desktop UPS of this size normally backs up a computer for minutes, so an 8 hour runtime is implausible without stating the load.
No photos of the case screws or the inside.

risks.risk: Unit does not power on or does not switch to battery when mains is cut.
risks.proof: A clip: unit plugged in and switched on with lights showing, a load such as a bulb or fan connected, then the wall socket switched off while the load stays on.

risks.risk: Battery is old or dead, so there is no backup time.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery label and date with the cover opened, plus the clip above timing the backup.

risks.risk: Capacity unknown; a lower VA rating is worth less.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate on the back or underside showing model and VA rating.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest rating in this case size

risks.risk: Has been opened and repaired, or the inverter board is damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the case screws and the inside with the cover off.

proof_requests: Photo of the rating plate showing model and VA rating.
Clip of the unit powering a load, then holding it when the mains is switched off.
Photo of the battery label and date.
Photo of the rear sockets and case screws.
response.reason: Photos 0 and 1 show a Blue Gate small desktop UPS, so it can be priced at its worst case: smallest rating for its size, battery dead and not working until a clip shows otherwise.
